scope: Coverage decisions for release-certified and production-supported upstream capabilities. A mapping documents a bounded MCP tool surface, not full parity with every Python API or independent installed-package compatibility evidence.

ir.scope: Circuit IR inspection, serialization, and parameter handling; not every Circuit method.

program_compilation.scope: Bounded optimization, full local compile pipeline, scheduling and topology routing/comparison, plus QCIS emission; not the full compiler API.

local_statevector.scope: Bounded in-process CPU circuit planning and simulation; no remote execution.

gradient_methods.scope: One bounded local parameter-training workflow; no general gradient or Jacobian tool.

openqasm_interchange.scope: OpenQASM emission only; import is not exposed as an MCP tool.

sharded_statevector_training.reason: Distributed training needs process ownership and resources outside this stateless, side-effect-free server.

two_node_statevector_training.reason: Multi-node launch and credentials are outside this local MCP server's boundary.

two_node_mps_training.reason: Multi-node launch and resource ownership are outside this local MCP server's boundary.

two_node_tensor_network_training.reason: Distributed tensor-network training requires an explicit safe execution contract before MCP exposure.

continuous_time_lindblad.scope: Bounded local CPU density-matrix evolution planning and execution on explicit time grids; no remote or hardware execution.

circuit_drawing.reason: Existing drawing tool predates the production-maturity rule. This record does not authorize adding another experimental tool.
